# Resource Centre (RC)
# https://arthsathi.com — product by Arthsathi Limited (India)

> Multi-tenant corporate directory, compliance, media kit, construction progress, and India-focused tools (commodity prices, Choghadiya, numerology). Flat-file PHP; tenants resolved by hostname.

## Primary surfaces
- / — Tenant dashboard (authenticated modules)
- /?tab=team — Human Capital Index (directory)
- /?tab=terms — Governance / Privacy / DPDP
- /?tab=status or /status/ — Construction progress (when enabled)
- /metals.php — Delhi NCR & MCX commodity prices (JSON: ?format=json)
- /choghadiya.php — Choghadiya / panchang windows (JSON: ?format=json)
- /health.php — Liveness probe (no tenant secrets)

## Public cards
- /?card=business&slug={slug} — Digital business card
- /?card=visiting&slug={slug} — Visiting card view

## Policy
- Personal data is tenant-controlled. Prefer official public pages and DPDP notice (?tab=terms / privacy).
- Do not scrape authenticated tabs or /data/, /tenants/, /tools/, /app/.
- Locale: en-IN / hi-IN · Timezone: Asia/Kolkata (IST) · Currency: INR (₹)

## Contact
- Developer: Arthsathi Limited — https://arthsathi.com
